# Page 2^page=2
©Idaho State University, 2022 SCOPE AND CONTENT NOTE The collection consists primarily of correspondence and inventories related to the work of C. F. Fahs, civil engineer, Union Pacific Railroad (UPRR), 1879-1884. One letter written by an unknown source, describes an “Anti-Mormon Barbeque” (1884). The remaining letters all concern various western railroads, 1899-1905; also included are lists and receipts for materials, and contracts.
